item.title: Middle Node.js Developer (Blockchain)
item.description:
We are looking for a Backend Developer to join our team.

Project: Our project is a mobile crypto payments product designed initially for students in Canada. It will allow users to hold fiat and crypto balances, receive funding from a parent or another sponsor, convert assets, make card payments, and send or receive bank and crypto transfers.

Requirements:

• 3+years of professional experience in backend development with Node.js
• Strong knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+) and familiarity with TypeScript
• Hands-on experience building RESTful APIs and/or GraphQL services
• Knowledge of databases
• Experience with ORM/ODM frameworks (Sequelize, TypeORM, Mongoose, Prisma, etc.).
• Experience with unit and integration testing
• Hands-on experience with Git and modern CI/CD workflows
• Understanding of Docker and containerized environments
• Experience with web3


What we offer:

• Remote working format
• Flexible working hours
• Informal and friendly atmosphere
• The ability to focus on your work: a lack of bureaucracy and micromanagement
• 20 paid vacation days
• 7 paid sick leaves
• Education reimbursement
 

Recruitment process: Recruitment Interview — Technical Interview

item.title: Backend Developer Node.js (AI Evaluation)
item.description:
Job Summary

As a Software Engineer, you will review AI-generated code and compare it with how you would write the solution yourself. Your main responsibility will be to evaluate AI-generated solutions, identify mistakes, and uncover reasoning gaps.
Right now, our developers are helping other engineers who work with AI get more accurate and reliable code. So, if you’ve ever written a prompt for AI and received a great answer, there’s a chance that work done by our developers helped make that answer better.

 

Requirements

  • 3-4 years of hands-on experience as a Software Developer on commercial projects, including B2B SaaS systems and data-heavy applications.
  • Use AI tools (AI agents, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar) in daily workflow.
  • Experience working with existing codebases and unfamiliar repositories
  • Strong experience with Node.js
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript / TypeScript
  • Experience with backend frameworks such as Express.js or NestJS or Fastify
  • Good understanding of REST API and backend architecture
  • Experience working with databases (SQL and/or NoSQL)
  • Ability to independently analyze code and identify bugs or inconsistencies
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Upper-Intermediate English (B2)

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Work with Frontier Labs, producing training data to train Al models.
  • Evaluate AI-generated code, technical solutions, and engineering approaches.
  • Identify bugs, incorrect assumptions, architectural issues, and weak reasoning in AI responses.
  • Test and evaluate agentic coding models designed to perform complex engineering tasks at a senior developer level.
  • Compare AI-generated solutions against senior engineering standards and best practices.

 

Bonus:

  • Computer Science or related education.
  • Learning new programming languages.
  • Strong understanding of algorithms and data structures.

 

This is not a traditional software development role. You will use your engineering expertise to analyze AI outputs, find issues in their solutions, and help train better AI systems.

item.title: Backend Developer (Node.js)
item.description:
We're looking for a Middle+/Senior Backend Developer - first and foremost a strong, well-rounded backend engineer. The role splits roughly 70/30: 70% designing and maintaining our external integrations (casino operators and partner platforms), 30% general backend/platform work and system design.

 

🚀 What you'll do

  • Design, build, and maintain integrations with casino operators and partner platforms (wallet/transaction APIs, game launch, and reporting contracts), owning the full lifecycle from contract design to production monitoring;
  • Build resilient integration layers: retries, idempotency, timeouts, error mapping, and graceful degradation when a third party misbehaves;
  • Contribute to core backend services and platform features - APIs, messaging flows, data models, shared modules;
  • Take part in slot game development on our game logic platform - implementing game mechanics and mathematics alongside the core team;
  • Define and improve integration testing practices: contract testing, mocking/stubs, e2e, and stress/load testing;
  • Work closely with Game Logic, Product, and DevOps teams to keep integration contracts stable as the platform evolves;
  • Participate in code reviews, technical decisions, and architecture discussions across the backend.

 

🧩 What you bring

  • 3-5+ years of backend development experience with Node.js + TypeScript, including ownership of non-trivial systems;
  • Proven experience designing and maintaining external integrations (REST/HTTP, XML/SOAP, RPC-style, or webhook-based);
  • Solid understanding of modular, service-oriented backend architecture, ideally from enterprise or scale-up environments;
  • Practical experience with message brokers (RabbitMQ or Kafka) and event-driven, queue-based design;
  • Strong grasp of integration testing approaches: contract testing, mocking, e2e, and stress testing;
  • Confident with PostgreSQL and Redis, CI/CD, Git, and monitoring/observability tools (Grafana, Loki, Tempo);
  • Comfortable with AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes for containerized deployments.

 

💎 Nice to have

  • Experience in iGaming, gambling platforms, or RNG/game provider integrations;
  • Familiarity with ArgoCD and GitOps workflows.

 

🎁 Benefits

  • 21 vacation days + 2 extra day-offs annually;
  • 12 paid sick days;
  • Fully remote format - work from anywhere you feel productive;
  • Flexible schedule: start your day anytime between 08:00-11:00 CET;
  • Fixed budget for health insurance and gym/fitness;
  • Provided all required work equipment;
  • Zero bureaucracy and direct communication with founders and C-level;
  • Minimal meetings, async-friendly workflow;
  • Startup energy: fast motion, creativity, and tight-knit communication;
  • Business trips and team meetups several times per year;
  • Multiple salary payout options (flexible formats);
  • …And many more perks unlocked after we hit break-even.
